description: Implement 100 quantitative trading strategies organized by category. Each strategy is a Python class extending the Strategy base class with a generate_signals() method. Categories: Momentum (15), Mean Reversion (15), Trend Following (10), Statistical Arbitrage (10), Factor-Based (15), Machine Learning (10), Volatility (10), Sentiment/Technical (15).
steps: Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/momentum/__init__.py and implement 15 momentum strategies in separate files: (1) simple_momentum.py - price momentum over N days, (2) dual_momentum.py - absolute + relative momentum, (3) momentum_acceleration.py - rate of change of momentum, (4) sector_momentum.py - sector rotation based on momentum, (5) earnings_momentum.py - earnings surprise momentum, (6) rsi_momentum.py - RSI-based momentum signals, (7) macd_momentum.py - MACD crossover momentum, (8) relative_strength.py - relative strength vs benchmark, (9) time_series_momentum.py - TSMOM factor, (10) cross_sectional_momentum.py - CSMOM ranking, (11) idiosyncratic_momentum.py - residual momentum after factor adjustment, (12) momentum_reversal.py - short-term reversal with long-term momentum, (13) volume_weighted_momentum.py - volume-confirmed momentum, (14) risk_adjusted_momentum.py - Sharpe-based momentum ranking, (15) adaptive_momentum.py - dynamic lookback momentum

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/mean_reversion/__init__.py and implement 15 mean reversion strategies: (1) bollinger_bands.py - Bollinger Band mean reversion, (2) pairs_trading.py - cointegrated pairs, (3) ornstein_uhlenbeck.py - OU process fitting, (4) zscore_reversion.py - z-score threshold trading, (5) kalman_filter_mr.py - Kalman filter spread tracking, (6) johansen_cointegration.py - multivariate cointegration, (7) half_life_mr.py - half-life based entry/exit, (8) rsi_reversion.py - RSI oversold/overbought reversion, (9) moving_average_reversion.py - distance from MA reversion, (10) mean_reversion_portfolio.py - portfolio-level mean reversion, (11) adf_based.py - ADF test based signal generation, (12) hurst_exponent.py - Hurst exponent regime detection, (13) variance_ratio.py - variance ratio test signals, (14) entropy_reversion.py - information entropy based, (15) cointegration_basket.py - basket mean reversion

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/trend_following/__init__.py and implement 10 trend following strategies: (1) moving_average_crossover.py - dual MA crossover, (2) turtle_trading.py - Donchian channel breakout, (3) adx_trend.py - ADX-based trend strength, (4) supertrend.py - ATR-based supertrend, (5) ichimoku.py - Ichimoku Cloud strategy, (6) parabolic_sar.py - SAR trailing stop trend, (7) linear_regression_channel.py - regression channel breakout, (8) keltner_channel.py - Keltner channel trend, (9) heikin_ashi.py - Heikin-Ashi candle trend, (10) aroon_trend.py - Aroon indicator trend

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/stat_arb/__init__.py and implement 10 statistical arbitrage strategies: (1) pca_stat_arb.py - PCA residual trading, (2) mean_field_arb.py - cross-sectional mean-field model, (3) copula_arb.py - copula-based dependency trading, (4) relative_value.py - relative value convergence, (5) etf_arb.py - ETF vs constituents arbitrage, (6) lead_lag.py - lead-lag relationship exploitation, (7) dispersion_trading.py - index vs components dispersion, (8) factor_neutral_arb.py - factor-neutral stat arb, (9) regime_switching_arb.py - regime-dependent spread trading, (10) microstructure_arb.py - order flow imbalance signals

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/factor/__init__.py and implement 15 factor strategies: (1) value_factor.py - book-to-market value, (2) size_factor.py - small-cap premium, (3) quality_factor.py - ROE/profitability quality, (4) low_volatility.py - low-vol anomaly, (5) dividend_yield.py - high dividend yield, (6) growth_factor.py - earnings/revenue growth, (7) liquidity_factor.py - illiquidity premium, (8) beta_factor.py - betting against beta, (9) accruals_factor.py - accruals anomaly, (10) investment_factor.py - conservative investment, (11) multi_factor.py - combined multi-factor model, (12) fundamental_factor.py - composite fundamental score, (13) technical_factor.py - composite technical score, (14) composite_alpha.py - alpha combination, (15) smart_beta.py - smart beta weighting

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/ml/__init__.py and implement 10 ML-based strategies: (1) random_forest_strategy.py - RF classification signals, (2) gradient_boosting.py - XGBoost/LightGBM signals, (3) lstm_strategy.py - LSTM time-series prediction (using numpy-based simple implementation), (4) svm_strategy.py - SVM classification, (5) kmeans_regime.py - K-means regime clustering, (6) pca_strategy.py - PCA dimensionality reduction signals, (7) logistic_regression.py - logistic regression probability, (8) naive_bayes.py - Bayesian classification, (9) decision_tree.py - decision tree rules, (10) ensemble_strategy.py - ensemble of multiple ML models

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/volatility/__init__.py and implement 10 volatility strategies: (1) garch_vol.py - GARCH volatility prediction, (2) vol_targeting.py - volatility targeting strategy, (3) vol_breakout.py - volatility breakout signals, (4) implied_realized_spread.py - IV vs RV spread, (5) vol_risk_premium.py - volatility risk premium harvesting, (6) vol_regime.py - volatility regime switching, (7) vol_mean_reversion.py - volatility mean reversion, (8) vol_momentum.py - volatility momentum, (9) vol_surface.py - vol surface term structure, (10) straddle_strategy.py - synthetic straddle approach

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/technical/__init__.py and implement 15 technical/sentiment strategies: (1) williams_r.py - Williams %R, (2) cci_strategy.py - CCI oscillator, (3) stochastic_oscillator.py - Stochastic %K/%D, (4) obv_strategy.py - On-Balance Volume, (5) money_flow.py - Money Flow Index, (6) vwap_strategy.py - VWAP deviation, (7) fibonacci_retracement.py - Fibonacci levels, (8) pivot_points.py - pivot point support/resistance, (9) elder_ray.py - Elder Ray bull/bear power, (10) dmi_strategy.py - Directional Movement Index, (11) trix_strategy.py - Triple EMA oscillator, (12) ultimate_oscillator.py - Ultimate Oscillator, (13) chaikin_oscillator.py - Chaikin Oscillator, (14) accumulation_distribution.py - AD line, (15) force_index.py - Elder Force Index
Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/registry.py - auto-discovery that imports all strategy classes and registers them, providing list_strategies() and get_strategy(name) functions
Create tests/test_strategies.py - test that all 100 strategies can be instantiated and generate_signals() returns valid DataFrames with proper signal format on sample data
acceptance_criteria: All 100 strategy classes exist and are importable
Each strategy extends the Strategy base class and implements generate_signals()
from quant_portfolio.strategies.registry import list_strategies; assert len(list_strategies()) >= 100
pytest tests/test_strategies.py passes - all strategies produce valid signal DataFrames
Each strategy has a docstring explaining its logic and parameters
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/portforlio_construction && python -c 'from quant_portfolio.strategies.registry import list_strategies; strategies = list_strategies(); print(f"Total strategies: {len(strategies)}"); assert len(strategies) >= 100'
findings: All 100 strategies implemented and registered. All 41 tests pass (34 pre-existing + 7 new). Fixed a pandas index alignment issue in PCA strategy with pandas 3.0+. ML strategies use scikit-learn with rolling retrain windows. Strategies that need multiple assets use single-asset proxies (moving average, volume ratio) for the secondary input.
